entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and invulnerable warrior who leads the army of Zendikar as Commander-General in the attempt to retake Sea Gate.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: A kor leader nicknamed The Spider for his tangle of ropes and hooks, who fights beside Gideon.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A commander with a gleaming halo around her neck who sounds the rallying horn and criticizes Gideon's lack of a plan.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: The bloodchief of the vampires of Guul Draz, who leads vampire troops in the army.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A roguish merfolk who brought a contingent of roilmages to Gideon's army.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker who arrives with a fleet of sea monsters to attack Sea Gate and claims to be commander-general of her own army; she has been to Theros.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who returns riding an elemental and brings Zendikar's elementals to the battle.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk in white coral armor who runs to the lighthouse to warn that Ulamog is coming.

entities.name: Vorik
entities.description: The leader of a survivors' camp who died of his wounds within days of reaching Emeria; he was inspired by Gideon.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The god of the sea on Theros, whom Kiora says she faced.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that is coming toward Sea Gate.

entities.name: Gideon's Irregulars
entities.description: Gideon's ragtag group of friends from his youth on Theros, several of whom died because of his arrogance.

entities.name: Army of Zendikar
entities.description: The ragtag host of kor, merfolk, elves, humans, goblins and vampires gathered by Gideon to retake Sea Gate.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The alien horde occupying Sea Gate, including spawn, flying and aquatic Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A once learned port city with a white dam, ruined wall and lighthouse, overrun by the Eldrazi and retaken by the army of Zendikar.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: The floating hedrons high above Tazeem where Gideon's army encamped.

entities.name: Halimar Sea
entities.description: The inland sea held back by the dam of Sea Gate.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The continent above which the hedrons of Emeria float.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of Gideon's youth, where he hurled Heliod's spear at the god of death.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane whose people and land rise against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Roilmages
entities.description: Mages who control the violence of Zendikar's roil, brought to the army by Noyan Dar.

entities.name: Vampires of Guul Draz
entities.description: Vampire troops from Guul Draz led by the bloodchief Drana who fight for Zendikar in Gideon's army.

events.summary: The army descends from the hedrons of Emeria, and Gideon leads its first march on Sea Gate with a shout of "For Zendikar!"
events.quote: He shouted, "For Zendikar!" and a deafening roar came in answer.

events.summary: Gideon leads a headlong charge against Eldrazi spawn and larger Eldrazi near Sea Gate, while many soldiers die.
events.quote: The spawn fell quickly under the initial charge

events.summary: Gideon recalls losing his Irregulars on Theros and fears he is again leading people to their deaths.
events.quote: So many of the Zendikari were dying.

events.summary: Cut off from his army, Gideon joins Munda, who tells him the army cannot win that day.
events.quote: "We're not going to win this," Munda said. "Not today."

events.summary: Gideon orders a retreat, which turns into a rout as the army dissolves, leaving Gideon, Munda and a few soldiers to hold off the Eldrazi.
events.quote: The ordered retreat turned into a rout.

events.summary: Tazri sounds a horn to rally the survivors, and the army regroups at camp as the sun sets.
events.quote: As the sun touched the horizon, the army of Zendikar was coming back together.

events.summary: Tazri tells Gideon the battle was a disaster because he led from the front and gave his army no plan or strategy.
events.quote: They need to know how they fit into the army and the overall plan of attack.

events.summary: Gideon realizes he has failed his commanders as well as his army and takes Tazri and Munda to work out a plan.
events.quote: "Walk with me, Tazri," he said.

events.summary: Over several days Gideon meets with the commanders and builds a plan that gives every contingent a role.
events.quote: Over the next few days, a plan came together.

events.summary: The army marches again in organized ranks to the beat of a conch-shell drum, with Noyan Dar's roilmages held back.
events.quote: They marched.

events.summary: A scout reports a fleet of sea monsters swimming toward Sea Gate and leaving Eldrazi remains behind them, and Gideon takes them for allies.
events.quote: "Allies, then," Gideon said. "At least for now."

events.summary: At dusk the army retreats in a planned maneuver and Drana's vampires take the front ranks, fighting through the night.
events.quote: But the maneuver went off without incident.

events.summary: Kiora appears on the tentacle of an enormous octopus and introduces herself, claiming command of her own army and the city.
events.quote: "I am Kiora," the merfolk said.

events.summary: Kiora summons a wave and her sea creatures tear into the Eldrazi, announcing the battle of Sea Gate has begun.
events.quote: The ocean churned as sharks and whales, serpents and krakens, tore into the Eldrazi.

events.summary: On the fourth day the army reaches the outer wall and then surges through it into Sea Gate.
events.quote: the army of Zendikar surged through the wall and entered Sea Gate.

events.summary: In the streets of the city the army's elves, goblins, kitesailers and eel-riders each play their role against the Eldrazi.
events.quote: That meant it was time to let other forces do what they did best.

events.summary: Elementals of tree and stone march through Sea Gate crushing the Eldrazi, and Gideon sees that Nissa has returned bringing Zendikar with her.
events.quote: Nissa had returned. And she had indeed brought Zendikar with her.

events.summary: The tide turns, and the Zendikari drive the Eldrazi out of the city.
events.quote: And the Zendikari had the upper hand. They were going to win!

events.summary: Fighting stops and Gideon sees from the lighthouse that the army has reclaimed Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
events.quote: But Sea Gate was theirs.

events.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Kiora gather in the lighthouse, and Jori En bursts in to warn that Ulamog is coming.
events.quote: "Ulamog is coming!"

relations.note: Gideon is the Commander-General of the army.
Munda fights back to back with Gideon.
relations.quote: The two of them had often ventured out from the camp to hunt Eldrazi, and they fought well together.

relations.note: Tazri is one of Gideon's commanders who calls him Commander-General.
Kiora accepts Gideon's help and fights Eldrazi alongside his army.
relations.quote: So I am happy to accept your help, Planeswalker.

relations.note: Kiora says she has faced the god Thassa on Theros.
relations.quote: I have faced a true god

relations.note: Drana is the bloodchief of the vampire troops.
relations.quote: their terrifying bloodchief, Drana, hovering overhead
